crossRefs.note: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting…
But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as…

translations.web: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,
translations.bsb: Are Your days like those of a mortal, or Your years like those of a man,
translations.kjv: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,
translations.asv: Are thy days as the days of man, Or thy years as man's days,
